text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu, haa*... Trainer.
I did it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It is by no means easy, but...
My legs... still have strength left in them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A faint smile after a strong run. But physically...
having made it through the summer, she seems to have developed a much sturdier build.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can we make it to the Kikuka-sho, or not?
I decided to consult Agnes Tachyon about her post-race physical condition as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! Judging from the flicker in Cafe's pupils
and the dilation of her capillaries, that means—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —It's fifty-fifty.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fifty-fifty... In other words, you don't know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Not knowing and a fifty-fifty chance are two different things.
It means I've learned that it's fifty-fifty."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
True, the stamina decline doesn't seem to be an issue.
However, the factor that still concerns me is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the hooves. Their condition remains dangerously fragile.
If we make a careless decision, Cafe might once again...
( R O O O O A R ! )

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump! Thump! Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A voiceless roar pierced straight through my mind, shaking
my very soul directly. The wild beast suddenly――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Eh... Wh-What...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can't... hear you well...
But, it feels so very...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A voice that not even Manhattan Cafe could hear.
Yet I felt its will clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (“Keep... moving... forward...”)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The presence that had guided Manhattan Cafe.
Yet also the presence that tried to drag Manhattan Cafe into the deep sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To believe, or not to believe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: Tell me what you're feeling, Cafe.
Tell me how you feel, Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in the Kikuka Sho. If my 'friend'
is calling for me, I want to be there as soon as possible..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I think. Her condition is better than in the summer,
and as for her hoof, our honed medical techniques
can somehow manage it. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of my 'friend' gave a slight nudge
to my judgment as a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, who can say whether it's scientific or unscientific?
Even that distinction isn't clear right now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "So you run in the Twinkle Series based on sixth sense? Hahaha..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: “—No way. I believed in Cafe's potential, and we're in the same boat together.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention whatsoever of closing off that possibility myself.
If it falls within the margin of error, why not ride along with your whims?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, go forth, Cafe!
And show me.
'Plan B'—the results of our very first verification!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not just for an experiment.
But..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Here I goâto the "Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our course of action was unanimously decided once again.
Manhattan Cafe is finally aiming for a GⅠ victory in the Kikuka Sho.
